notice: Modified by Evnola OU on 2026-11-08: in create_freetype_package_config of scripts/function-apple.sh, libbrotlidec is removed from the Requires.private line of the generated freetype2.pc.
reason: FreeType is built without brotli (patch 05), so no libbrotlidec.pc exists, but the freetype2.pc that Next writes by hand still declares libbrotlidec as a private requirement. Every pkg-config consumer of freetype2 (fontconfig, libass, FFmpeg) would stop with 'Package libbrotlidec was not found'. The line declares a dependency that does not exist.
